paper_title: Axion Star Explosions: A New Source for Axion Indirect Detection
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 3
notes: Cosmological bound from Planck CMB optical depth (tau_reio < 0.068, exclusion criterion tau > 0.03 from axion star explosions at 6 < z < 50). The paper excludes a CLOSED region in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane: roughly 1e-14 GeV^-1 < g_agamma < 1e-10 GeV^-1 for 1e-14 eV < m_a < 1e-8 eV (benchmark core-halo relation alpha=2/5). The two emitted points approximate the LOWER boundary (strongest-coupling edge) of the exclusion band as a flat line over the stated validity range; the actual boundary in Figure 3 is mass-dependent and could not be read precisely from text. Note the exclusion also has an UPPER boundary at ~1e-10 GeV^-1 (structure formation suppression), so couplings above that are NOT excluded by this work. Assumes axions constitute all of dark matter and enhanced photon coupling / suppressed quartic self-coupling. 21cm sensitivity projections (order of magnitude improvement) also discussed but not included as they are projections.
